title: Dead Cities
description: A post-apocalyptic modpack inspired by S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Explore dead cities, scavenge for resources, find powerful weapons, and survive against deadly parasites in a world devastated by nuclear war.
body:
# Dead Cities

Have you ever wanted to become a stalker in a world destroyed by nuclear catastrophe? **Dead Cities** throws you into a harsh post-apocalyptic wasteland where survival is your only goal.

Explore abandoned cities, loot ruined buildings for valuable supplies, gather weapons and equipment, and fight against deadly parasites that have taken over the remains of civilization. Every journey can reward you with rare loot—or become your last.

# Features

* Immersive post-apocalyptic atmosphere
* Exploration of abandoned cities and structures
* Extensive looting and scavenging gameplay
* Wide variety of weapons and gear
* Dangerous parasites and hostile threats
* Challenging survival experience

The world has fallen. Resources are scarce. Danger lurks around every corner.

**Will you survive the Dead Cities?**
